nota: 'There have been 11 previously well-documented envenomings by O. microlepidotus, but only 2 were inflicted by wild snakes' (resumo). O artigo descreve o 12.º, de cobra selvagem, no sertão da Austrália do Sul. 'Well-documented' é a palavra da fonte: 'a dozen cases … written up' está fiel.

pedidos.pedido: F097, F098: Weinstein et al. 2017: 11 envenenamentos bem documentados antes + o do artigo = 12

texto_aprovado: With a title like that, you might expect a long medical record, and it's a short one. By 2017, doctors had written up only about a dozen cases of someone bitten by an inland taipan and injected with venom. Only three of those bites came from a snake in the wild.
